title: In characteristic p a geometrically reduced field extension is separable
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number, let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p$ and let $K/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] such that for every field extension $L/k$ the ring $K\otimes_kL$ is reduced (has no nonzero nilpotent elements). Then $K$ is separable over $k$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension] (2): every subextension $k\subset K'\subset K$ with $K'$ finitely generated as a field over $k$ is separably generated over $k$.
